item.title: Billionaire Buys Steamboat Springs Apartment Complex and Turns It Into Affordable Housing
item.description: In the face of rising housing costs, a billionaire purchased an apartment building in Steamboat Springs, Colorado and turned it into affordable housing.

item.description: Indonesia is full of amazing waves. Famous ones like Uluwatu, Lance's Right, and. Bingin There are plenty of not-so-famous waves that often fly under the radar.

item.title: A New Plastic Is Here, and It Biodegrades In Salt Water in Just a Few Hours
item.description: Researchers have made a leap in the fight against plastic pollution. A new material created from cellulose could be the beginnings of something amazing.

item.title: Kayakers Get Up Close and Personal with Tiger Shark in Western Australia
item.description: An Australian couple's encounter is going viral for their hilarious reaction to an encounter with a tiger shark.

item.title: Meet James Nash: Rancher, Hunter, Combat Veteran, Wildland Firefighter, and Podcast Host
item.description: If you ask him, James Nash says he’s just a normal American guy. He grew up on an Oregon ranch, trapping gophers and working as a pack horse hunting guide in high school. He also wrestled so well that he moved to Norway for a year to train professionally. His career choices varied after that: he earned a college scholarship for riding rodeo broncos, and paid the rest of his tuition by working as a wildland firefighter in the summer. item.title: Austin Surf Club Releases Rendering of Its New Wave Pool
item.description: The Austin Surf Club, which uses Kelly Slater Wave Co. technology, just released an image of what the place is going to look like when it opens its doors.

item.title: Laura Crane May Have Broken Record for Biggest Wave Ridden by a Woman

item.title: Meepo Flow Electric Skateboard Review: Surfy Lines, Serious Power
item.description: I've spent the past couple of months testing the Meepo Flow, an electric skateboard with surf-inspired carving ability. It's a powerful ride with impressive internals, and Dual Kingpin Trucks that allow for carving at speed.

item.title: Bondi Surfers Hold Paddle-Out In Honor of Mass Shooting Victims
